quote: Estate liens will be filled when stated in regulations
explanation: The policy says estate liens will be filed when regulations allow, but it does not say patients who qualify for charity care or discounts are excluded. Ask the hospital whether it would place a lien on property of a qualifying patient or their estate.

quote: Agencies are prohibited from using Extraordinary Collection Actions (ECAs) , including lawsuits, wage garnishments, or liens on primary residences for low- income patients
explanation: This sentence forbids collection agencies from placing liens on the homes of low income patients. It does not allow a lien.

quote: BDR performs comprehensive research to identify income, real property, and other financial assets
explanation: The collection agency looks for real property before suing, and the policy does not say it will spare patients who qualify for charity care or discounts. Ask the hospital whether a judgment could become a lien on a qualifying patient's home.

quote: Foreclosure on real or personal property;
explanation: This is part of a federal list that defines extraordinary collection actions. It does not say the hospital forecloses on the property of patients who qualify for help.

quote: The hospital will not use wage garnishments or liens on , all real property
explanation: The policy elsewhere bans liens on any real property of patients who qualify for discounts or sponsored care. The general lien sentence applies only to other patients.

quote: Lien on a residence or any other personal or real property;
explanation: This is part of a federal list that defines extraordinary collection actions. It does not say the hospital places liens on the property of patients who qualify for help.

quote: use wage garnishments or liens on primary residences
explanation: The hospital promises no liens on the primary home of qualifying patients, but California now protects all real property they own. Ask whether the hospital could place a lien on other property you own.

quote: use wage garnishments or liens on any real property
explanation: The hospital promises not to place liens on any real property of patients who qualify for financial assistance. That follows the law.

quote: Under certain circumstances when income does not exceed 400% FPL, PIH’s collection agency may file a lien on a primary residence
explanation: The policy lets the collection agency put a lien on the home of a patient with income at or below 400% of the poverty level. Those patients qualify for discounts, and California law forbids liens on their real property.

quote: file liens on assets except if court ordered
explanation: The policy allows liens on assets with a court order and does not exclude patients who qualify for charity care or discounts. California law bans liens on their real property with no court order exception.

quote: Liens on any real property owned, in whole or in part by the Patient
explanation: This sentence is on a list of things the collection agency may not do to patients who qualify for charity care or discounts. It follows the law.

quote: include a lien; foreclosure on real property;
explanation: This sentence only defines what counts as an extraordinary collection action under federal rules. It does not say the hospital liens the property of qualifying patients.

quote: liens on primary residences except as provided below
explanation: The policy bars liens on primary homes except in cases it does not show here, and it says nothing about other real property. Ask the hospital whether it could place a lien on property of a patient who qualifies for help.
